ITEM 1 | Bright orange-red cubed pieces, roughly 2 cm each, with a matte, slightly textured surface and some darker browned edges; a few pieces sit in a loose cluster on a white plate, with a thin orange-red film/smear pooled around them that looks like seasoning or sauce residue | 85

ITEM 2 | Thin orange-red sauce or seasoning residue smeared across the white plate bottom and around the cubes, flat with slight sheen, no defined shape | 5

ITEM 3 | Single darker brown-red cube at the right edge of the cluster, roughly 2 cm, with a more browned, dense-looking surface than the orange pieces | 8
